description:
[Game reference] One monument's puzzle: every door, what opens it in order, resets and loot. `doors`: each puzzle door (`door` kind, `card` colour or null, `count` identical doors, `area` = the room's name in the
game files when it has one) with `ways` to open it - ordered `steps` (`t` = grid/fuse/switch/timer/card/button with
`seconds`, `colour`, `stage`, and a readable `text`) and `stays_open` - plus `exit_button` and `resets` (indexes into
`resets`). `resets`: each PuzzleReset (`seconds`, `players_block` + `radius` or `ai_zone`, `pause_until_looted`,
`radiation_push`) with the `loot` it respawns (`name`, `max` per reset, `url` to the loot table or item).
`radiation`: zones by tier. `missions`: missions the monument's NPCs give. Steps are in order (power grid, fuse, switch, timer, card, button). Radiation: protection equal to the rad number blocks it. Link https://rust.wiki/monument/<slug>#puzzle.
name: get_monument_puzzle
title: One monument's puzzle: every door, what opens it in order, resets and loot
